title: Sonos ZonePlayer S5
summary: The Sonos ZonePlayer S5, priced at $399, is a self-contained, single-box solution for streaming audio, offering easy setup and integration with existing Sonos systems. Reviewer Kim Wilson highlights its portability and suitability for various locations like a garage studio, controlled efficiently via free Sonos apps for iPhone and iPad. This product, now known as Play:5, is praised for its ability to stream audio from a wide range of sources without needing a dedicated sound system.

title: Amazon Buy UK’s Biggest Movie Rental Service LOVEFiLM
summary: Amazon has announced its acquisition of LOVEFiLM International Limited, the UK's largest online movie rental service. Amazon, which already held a 42% stake in LOVEFiLM, will buy the remaining shares, further expanding its presence in the European entertainment market. The deal, expected to close in Q1 2011, will combine LOVEFiLM's subscription service for DVDs, games, and streaming with Amazon's resources to enhance customer experience.
